health.label: Ratings v Pinnacle
health.note: typical miss on the close a week out, since Sep 26; bias = close minus ratings, home side

health.label: Spread
health.note: slope of Pinnacle's close on our ratings (1.00 = right spread); above 1 the favourites' futures run low, below 1 they run high

health.label: Draws
health.note: model v Pinnacle's devigged draw rate on this season's closes; knockout draws go to a coin flip, so a draw gap moves every playoff round

issues.text: 34 games with no Pinnacle close (Aug 16 to Oct 1, market-average used)
issues.detail: OpticOdds has an opener but no close for them (suspended markets) and the 10-minute capture only began on Oct 14, so they cannot be recovered; the average close is within about 1 point of Pinnacle's on the home win
